title: Overwhelming scent
text: Overwhelming scent. The scent was overbearing. I had bought a jasmine before and it wasn't as heavy of a perfume smell. If you can handle send buy it. It would be worth the money. For me it was a waste. I've only burned it once. So if you are sensitive like me don't buy this scent.
